Italian Pantry.name: Ciobar Classico
Italian Pantry.description:
Ciobar – Italian Hot Chocolate
Iconic Italian drinking chocolate, thick, rich, and intensely chocolatey. Made in the classic Italian style, Ciobar is smooth, velvety, and deeply comforting—closer to a dessert than a drink. Perfect for chocolate lovers craving something warm and indulgent.

Italian Pantry.name: Trucillo Cremoso Ground Coffee 250g
Italian Pantry.description:
Trucillo Ground Coffee – Cremoso (250g)
Premium Italian ground coffee by Trucillo, crafted for a smooth, full-bodied espresso with a rich crema. This balanced blend delivers notes of chocolate and toasted grains with a velvety finish. Perfect for moka pot or espresso-style at home. Authentic Neapolitan coffee tradition in every cup.

Italian Pantry.name: Trucillo Moka Ground Coffee
Italian Pantry.description:
Trucillo Moka Coffee
Authentic Italian ground coffee by Trucillo, expertly blended for moka pot. Rich and full-bodied with smooth crema and balanced notes of chocolate and roasted aromas. A classic Neapolitan-style coffee that delivers a bold yet rounded cup, perfect for everyday espresso at home.

Pasta.name: Malloreddus Gnocchetti Sardi
Pasta.description:
Malloreddus (Gnocchetti Sardi)
Traditional Sardinian pasta made from durum wheat, shaped into small ridged shells that perfectly hold sauce. Tender yet hearty, these handcrafted gnocchetti deliver authentic Mediterranean flavor in every bite. A true Italian classic, simple, comforting, and deeply satisfying.

Pasta.name: Fregola Tostata
Pasta.description:
Fregola Tostata
Traditional Sardinian toasted pasta made from semolina, rolled into small pearls and gently oven-roasted for a nutty, rich flavor. With a texture similar to couscous but heartier, fregola is rustic, comforting, and perfect for soaking up sauces and broths. A unique island specialty with deep Mediterranean character.

Pasta.name: Mezzi Rigatoni Di Martino
Pasta.description:
Mezzi Rigatoni Di Martino
Premium Italian pasta from Gragnano, crafted by Di Martino using 100% Italian durum wheat and bronze dies for a rough texture that perfectly holds sauce. Short, ridged tubes with a firm bite, ideal for rich tomato, meat, or creamy sauces. Authentic, hearty, and deeply satisfying.

Pasta.name: Rigatoni Di Martino
Pasta.description:
Rigatoni Di Martino
Authentic pasta from Gragnano by Di Martino, made with 100% Italian durum wheat and bronze-cut for a rough surface that clings to sauce. Large ridged tubes with a satisfying bite, perfect for bold tomato sauces, slow-cooked meats, or creamy classics. A true Italian staple with depth and character.

Pasta.name: Penne Mezzani Rigate Di Martino
Pasta.description:
Penne Mezzani Rigate Di Martino
Classic Italian pasta from Gragnano by Di Martino, made with 100% Italian durum wheat and bronze-cut for a textured surface that grips sauce. Short, ridged penne with a firm, satisfying bite, perfect for everything from bright tomato sauces to creamy or vegetable-based preparations. Versatile, comforting, and authentically Italian.
